name: immersive_5_1
character: Discrete 5.1: the five-loudspeaker ring at listener ear level with one low-frequency channel.
label: 5.1 (ITU-R BS.2051 System B)
sources: ITU-R BS.2051-3: System B is the 5.1 loudspeaker layout (0+5+0)
ITU-R BS.1770: loudness is measured on the delivered channels with the layout's own channel weights, the low-frequency channel excluded (`loudness.method`: bs1770_layout)

The linked limiter (5 ms look-ahead, 120 ms release, at most 6 dB of reduction) and the fold-down band limit (6 dB) are starting values, not measured ones; the -3.0 dBTP ceiling is this project's delivery policy for a multichannel file
